chunks: Whatever is in it from 'Asim ibn Humayd, I have transmitted it from my father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah have mercy on them both—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from 'Asim ibn Humayd.

key_terms.رَحِمَهُمَا اللَّهُ: may Allah have mercy on them both

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of Shaykh al-Saduq to 'Asim ibn Humayd in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad by which the author transmits narrations from 'Asim ibn Humayd in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It serves as a chain-authentication notice, identifying the intermediaries through whom these hadith reach the compiler.
